title: Vogelzang DR55 55-Gallon Heavy-Duty Bead-Blasted Steel Barrel for Camp Stove Kits
description: The US Stove DR55 closed head sealed steel drum barrel is unpainted and suitable for use with any barrel camp stove kit. The barrel camp stove is one of the most basic stove designs. The DR55 barrels have been used, cleaned and then bead blasted. The DR55 drums have not been painted so there may be small areas of surface rust that can easily be sanded out. Oils may be present on the surfaces that will need to be burned off during the initial use. The DR55 can be used with the BSK1000 model for a complete barrel camp stove kit.
